title: Wideband Transmit Array
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Transmitters and Receivers/Wideband_Transmit_Array.md
text: Receiver, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Output IP3 (dBm)} sets Output IP3; {Enable signal enabling input} sets the enablng signal input, {Add noise to input signal}, {Input noise temperature (K)}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate 1e6, {Inherit sample rate}, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Noise method}, {Noise figure (dB)}, {Noise factor}, {Reference temperature (K)}, {Gain method}, {Gain (dB)} sets the linear receiver gain, {Lookup table}, {Phased offset (degrees)} sets the phase offset, {Source of seed for random number generator} and {Seed for random number generator}. Values come from the instance.
